tickets.title: Order food by phone
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to order food on my phone, so that I can order while walking from class and reduce the time I spend waiting in the cafeteria queue.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The student can view available food items.
- The student can add food items to an order.
- The student can submit the order from the phone.
- The system confirms that the order was successfully submitted.

tickets.title: Filter menu by allergens
tickets.description:
As a Student with a food allergy, I want to filter the menu by allergens, so that I do not see foods containing ingredients I need to avoid.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The student can select an allergen filter such as No Peanuts.
- The menu hides items that contain the selected allergen.
- Items containing the selected allergen are not displayed while the filter is active.
- The student can remove the filter and view the full menu again.

tickets.title: Receive daily special notification
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to receive a push notification about the daily special at 11:30 AM, so that I can learn about available discounts before ordering lunch.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The system can send a push notification to students who have notifications enabled.
- The notification is scheduled for 11:30 AM.
- The notification contains the daily special and its discount.
- Students who have disabled notifications do not receive the notification.

tickets.title: Mark food item as Sold Out
tickets.description:
As an Administrator/Staff, I want to mark a food item as Sold Out instantly, so that students cannot order an item after it is no longer available.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Authorized staff can mark an available food item as Sold Out.
- The item is immediately shown as Sold Out.
- Students cannot add a Sold Out item to a new order.
- The item can be made available again by authorized staff.

tickets.title: View incoming orders on kitchen display
tickets.description:
As an Administrator/Staff, I want to see incoming food orders on the kitchen display, so that kitchen staff can prepare orders as they arrive.

Acceptance Criteria:
- New orders appear on the kitchen display.
- Each order shows the ordered food items.
- The kitchen staff can see newly received orders without manually refreshing the page.
- Orders remain visible until they are processed.

analysis.ambiguity1: The requirement to order food on a phone while walking from class is vague because it does not specify how students should place an order, what information is required, or when the order is considered confirmed.
analysis.ambiguity2: The requirement for the kitchen display system to work offline for at least 10 minutes is vague because it does not specify which functions must remain available offline or how orders should be handled and synchronized when the connection is restored.
analysis.conflictSolution: The Chef needs sold-out items to be unavailable immediately, while the IT team requires the kitchen display system to continue working offline. The system should allow the kitchen to mark an item as Sold Out locally while offline, store the change locally, and synchronize it with the central system when the connection is restored.
analysis.nfr1: Performance: The ordering system should allow students to place food orders quickly to reduce cafeteria queue times.
analysis.nfr2: Availability: The kitchen display system should continue operating offline for at least 10 minutes without crashing and synchronize data when the connection is restored.
analysis.nfr3: Usability: The menu should provide an easy-to-use allergy filter so students can quickly hide foods containing specified allergens.
